newsitem.title: USA: CIBC Wood Gundy appoints asset group head.
newsitem.headline: CIBC Wood Gundy appoints asset group head.

text.p: CIBC Wood Gundy said on Tuesday it had appointed M. Elizabeth Byck as head of its Global Asset Based Finance Group, responsible for the firm's structured finance and advisory business.
Byck joined CIBC in 1979 and held management positions in the firms's taxation and leasing areas before her promotion, CIBC Wood Gundy said in a statement.
CIBC Wood Gundy is the marketing banner under which Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce and its CIBC Wood Gundy Securities affiliates offer banking services.
